Tell me about your project

I work with marine science and environmental organizations on underwater imaging, research workflows, and software for exploring data.

Ways I can help

  • Document marine environments: underwater photogrammetry, survey design, 3D reconstruction, and mapping for baseline studies and repeat monitoring.
  • Improve research workflows: automate image processing and data preparation, with checkpoints for measurements and scientific review.
  • Build tools for working with data: viewers, interactive visualizations, and custom applications designed around the people who use them.

Get in touch

Tell me what you're working on, who needs to use the results, and where you need help. If you already have data, a field campaign, or a deadline in mind, include that too.
